title: What happens if you stay awake for 3 days? Day 1

beats.text: What happens to a person who doesn't sleep for three days? This is Jake. In just 24 hours, his brain will work like a drunk driver's.
Day one. Seven in the morning. Jake won't sleep again for 72 hours. Let's watch what happens, hour by hour.
For the first 15 hours, it's just a normal day. Coffee, work, dinner. Nothing feels wrong. Then the sun goes down.
Hour 16. Bedtime. A chemical called adenosine has been piling up in his brain all day. The more it builds, the sleepier he gets.
Hour 17. His reactions are now as slow as someone who's been drinking.
Three in the morning. His body clock hits its lowest point. This is the hardest hour to stay awake.
Hour 22. His hunger hormone is up, and he's raiding the fridge for junk food.
Then, something weird. The sun comes up, and he suddenly feels awake again. That's his body clock, not real energy.
Because at hour 24, his brain is as impaired as someone who's legally drunk.
And tomorrow, his brain starts switching off without asking. Could you make it to day two? Follow to see what happens to Jake.
